flow.detail: It knows your slots, for example a morning and an evening slot every day, and it answers the date question first because that is what the customer asked. On Starter it works from the calendar you give us and your team confirm the slot. On Pro it reads your booking engine and only offers a slot that is open. In the agent we built, it is blocked from saying a date is free or taken when it cannot see a calendar.

flow.step: It puts the group on the right boat and quotes the real price
flow.detail: The occasion, the guest count and the date decide the boat. It recommends one boat with a reason and gives the price for the slot in the same message. It sends the photo too, because people choose a boat with their eyes. Then it offers the one or two add-ons that fit, BBQ for a family day, DJ for a party, each with its own price. If two of your boats are the same model at the same price, it says so and does not invent a difference. If your boats leave from different marinas, it names the right one for the boat chosen.

flow.step: It answers the policy questions on the spot
flow.detail: What if it rains, can we fish, can we bring our own food, can we bring the dog, how many can come, what time do we arrive. These are your published rules, so it answers them in the first reply and then asks for the date. It never hands a published policy to a human.

flow.step: It takes the deposit and writes the booking
flow.detail: It recaps the boat, the date, the slot, the guest count and each add-on with its price, then sends the deposit or full payment link, whichever is your rule. On Pro the booking is written into your booking engine and your CRM, and your team are notified in the same turn with everything they need for the day.

flow.step: It hands over what it should not price, and follows up the rest
flow.detail: A group above your guest cap, or an event you price by hand, gets the date, the headcount and a contact captured, then goes to your team with a note that a real number is coming. It does not guess. Anyone who goes quiet gets a follow-up, and a no on this date is left open for the next one.

faq: Can an AI agent answer yacht charter enquiries on WhatsApp?

Yes, if it is built on your fleet. 41 Closer is loaded with your boats, your slots, your add-ons and your policies. It answers 'available 15th sat?', 'how many pax' and 'what if rain' from that, at any hour. It quotes the real price for the boat that fits the group. Anything it cannot price it hands to your team with the date and the headcount captured.
How does it know whether the boat is free on that date?

On Starter it works from the calendar you give us, and your team confirm the slot. It will not say a date is free when it cannot see one. On Pro it reads your booking engine live, so it knows which slots are open before it quotes. The operator we built for used Rezdy, and that is the kind of system Pro connects.

On Pro, yes. It sends the deposit or full payment link in the chat, whichever is your rule, and the booking is written back to your system. On Starter it hands the agreed booking to your team and they take payment as they do now.
What happens when someone asks for a corporate event bigger than my boat can take?

If the group is above the guest cap on your licence, it says so and offers the option you have for bigger groups, a dockside party for example. It never confirms a charter above the cap. For an event with no published price it captures the date, the headcount and a contact and sends them to you in the same turn. The customer is told a real number is coming from your team. It does not guess a price for an event that size.

No. Every price it gives comes from the catalogue you gave us, and a figure that is not in there is blocked before the customer sees it. Yes. It answers 24 hours a day, including when nobody is at a desk. The weekday enquiry that used to wait until the next day gets the boat, the price and the slot in the first reply. Your team see the booking when it lands.
